Late last night, a short update for pet owners
It concerns the desk

Pet Travel Notice

Travelers should note that the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways is handling current companion animal checks with extra care.

Our records show that pet bookings, crate checks, and transfer handoffs remain under review while the safety coordinator and ground team keep watch for risks. <<FACT F116>> Please keep all travel papers ready and follow the desk directions at the gate. If a carrier is delayed or a connection is missed, the desk will log the case and continue the review. <<FACT F110>> Our staff will keep travelers informed and move each pet through the service in a steady way.

Please do not crowd the work area or change a carrier label after check-in. The desk is the right place for updates, and travelers should report any concern there at once.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
